format: SOL stars3d v1: Float32 x10 [x,y,z pc; vx,vy,vz pc/yr; M; Teff; flags; σd/d], J2000 ecliptic, epoch J2016.0
sources: Gaia Catalogue of Nearby Stars — Gaia Collaboration, Smart et al. 2021, A&A 649, A6 (VizieR J/A+A/649/A6) via https://tapvizier.cds.unistra.fr; Gaia data CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
Hipparcos new reduction, van Leeuwen 2007 (VizieR I/311/hip2) via https://tapvizier.cds.unistra.fr

cuts.hip: Hp < 6.5, Plx/e_Plx > 5, no Gaia match within 90″ and 1.2 mag

truth: positions OBSERVED (astrometry); distances DERIVED (GCNS Bayesian posterior medians; Hipparcos 1/parallax); Teff DERIVED; completeness: Gaia DR3 incompleteness at G<3 and in crowded fields
